critical_flags.justification: S3 presents the H1 pipeline as the paper's methodological contribution ('Our contribution is to run this discipline across a whole census of 13,351 instances whose formulas are Lean terms, keeping only hashes, and to close the one instance ... by a cube partition whose composition is proved in Lean'). The closest prior work for exactly this pairing, the Lean 4 formal verification of the empty-hexagon number (Subercaseaux, Nawrocki, Gallicchio, Codel, Carneiro, Heule, ITP 2024; Lean-verified SAT encoding with a cake_lpr-checked cube-and-conquer proof) and the Heule-Scheucher empty-hexagon SAT result (TACAS 2024), is neither cited nor engaged. The declared audience includes formal-methods readers, for whom this is the obvious precedent. Reviewer recall (web_search false); resolve via paper-litsearch, then add a positioning sentence that keeps the new parts (census scale, check-then-discard, bank re-validation, stratum reduction) as the contribution.
